use: Distance to streams as drainage/toe-erosion proxy
notes: Notebook retrieves river/stream/canal/drain features for the Yatinuwara polygon.

dataset: NASA Global Landslide Catalog / COOLR point layer
use: Low-weight historical-instability prior and independent inventory evidence
notes: Notebook queries a 25 km buffer. If no usable events exist, this factor is omitted and remaining S weights are renormalized.
